visual_review.identity: Muted olive/gray-green meadow planes with broken tan-brown soil openings, sparse embedded gray stone groups and simple broad grass marks. Preserves stony grass/earth hill-ground identity without new cliff or slope geometry.
visual_review.style_review: About ten main stone groups and broad grass planes, harmonizing strongly with approved meadow base. More secondary grass/soil contour fragments and grassy marks than the strict six-to-ten main regions. Stone faces retain multiple small facets and some brighter face fragments, but no uniform micropebble field.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Much greener and brighter than the original muddy/olive swatch, intentionally influenced by the approved meadow base. Compare against both original and approved-base mean colors in aggregate QA; exact original palette matching is not claimed.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Stone groups roughly140-220 native pixels,14-22 world units at128 or29-45 at256. Several exposed-earth openings form loose diagonal bands that remain material color, not roads.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque actual-used tone2 candidate;68 code-derived hill cells.128/256 preview and actual scene acceptance pending; no natural seamlessness claim.

reference_material_identity: Olive grass broken by brown earth and larger/denser gray stones; actual hill tone 2, distinct from uniformly grassy meadow.
